mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE ) SELECT DISTINCT u.admin_user_id, u.login_id, u.display_name, organization.organization_name, u.account_status, u.consecutive_failures, u.locked_until, u.last_login_at FROM seal.admin_user u JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = u.organization_unit_id JOIN seal.organization_unit organization ON organization.organization_unit_id = u.organization_unit_id ORDER BY u.display_name, u.login_id

SELECT role.role_id, role.role_code, role.role_name, role.system_role, role.active, count(DISTINCT user_role.admin_user_id) AS user_count, count(DISTINCT role_permission.permission_id) AS permission_count FROM seal.admin_role role LEFT JOIN seal.user_role user_role ON user_role.role_id = role.role_id LEFT JOIN seal.role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = role.role_id GROUP BY role.role_id, role.role_code, role.role_name, role.system_role, role.active ORDER BY role.system_role DESC, role.role_code
